## How I checked it

- [ ] `npx next typegen && npx tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] For anything visible: looked at it at phone size (390x844, touch) and desktop size, and attached screenshots

## Before merging

- [ ] One topic only (no unrelated clean-ups mixed in)
- [ ] No secrets, personal details or real server addresses in code, screenshots or text
- [ ] README / docs updated if behavior or settings changed
- [ ] If this changes the database schema: I ran `npm run db:generate` and included the new migration
